ambition
志向
How would you pursue an ambition without letting it take over every part of your life?
I would turn the ambition into steady weekly work. I would also protect relationships and rest instead of postponing them indefinitely.
我會把志向拆成每週穩定做的事。也保留關係和休息，不把它們無限往後擺。
purpose
目的
How would you check whether an activity still served its original purpose?
I would compare its purpose with what it actually achieves now. A familiar routine may need to change when the situation changes.
我會比較原本目的和現在實際做到的事。情況改變了，熟悉的做法也可能需要調整。
aim
目標
What would be a useful aim for your first month in a new role?
My aim would be to understand the main responsibilities and people involved. Trying to change everything immediately could create unnecessary confusion.
我的目標是先了解主要責任和相關的人。一開始就什麼都想改，可能只會製造混亂。
strategy
策略
How would you change a strategy that was not producing results?
I would examine which part of the strategy was failing before replacing everything. A small test could show whether one adjustment was enough.
我會先找策略哪一段沒奏效，不整套推翻。做個小測試，看看改一個地方夠不夠。
approach
方法
When would you try a different approach instead of putting in more effort?
I would change my approach after repeated attempts revealed the same obstacle. More effort alone would not fix a method that missed the problem.
反覆嘗試都卡在同一處，我就會換方法。方向沒對到問題，光更努力也沒有用。
process
過程
Which part of a complicated process would you simplify first?
I would simplify the part of the process that repeatedly causes confusion. Clearer instructions there could prevent several later mistakes.
我會先簡化過程中一直讓人困惑的部分。那裡說明清楚，就可能避免後面好幾個錯誤。
step
步驟
What would be a small first step towards a project you have been avoiding?
My first step would be writing a rough outline for fifteen minutes. I would not require the opening attempt to solve the entire project.
第一個步驟，是花十五分鐘寫粗略大綱。不要求剛開始，就把整個計畫都解決。
phase
階段
How would you know when a project was ready to move into its next phase?
The next phase should begin when the agreed requirements are met. Feeling impatient would not replace checking the current work.
約好的條件達成後，才進入下一階段。想快點往前，不能代替檢查目前成果。
objective
目標
How would you define a clear objective for a short community project?
The objective would be to make the shared garden easier to use. We could measure success by asking residents about the specific changes.
目標會是讓共用花園更方便使用。我們可以詢問居民，具體改變是否真的有幫助。
subjective
主觀
How would you handle subjective feedback when several people preferred different designs?
I would separate subjective preferences from practical requirements. We could test readability even if we disagreed about which colour looked nicest.
我會把主觀喜好和實際需求分開。就算喜歡的顏色不同，仍能測試字好不好讀。
achieve
達成
What would help you achieve a goal that depended on regular small actions?
I would choose a routine I could repeat to achieve the goal. Tracking completed sessions would show effort without demanding perfect days.
要達成目標，我會選能重複的日常安排。記下完成次數，看得到努力，也不要求每天完美。
accomplish
完成
How would you decide what you could realistically accomplish in one afternoon?
I would choose one result I could accomplish with the time available. Finishing a useful part would be better than starting five unrelated tasks.
我會選一個下午真的能完成的成果。做好有用的一部分，比開了五件不相關的事好。
attempt
嘗試
What would make a first attempt worthwhile even if it failed?
The attempt would be worthwhile if it revealed a specific problem. I could use that information to make the next trial more focused.
如果能看出具體問題，第一次嘗試就值得。這些資訊，能讓下次試得更有方向。
effort
努力
How do you decide where extra effort is most likely to help?
I put extra effort into the part I can actually influence. Repeatedly polishing an unimportant detail could leave the main problem untouched.
我會把努力放在自己真能影響的地方。一直修飾小細節，可能讓主要問題原封不動。
persist
堅持
When is it sensible to persist, and when should you reconsider the plan?
I would persist if I was learning and the goal still mattered. Repeated harm or an irrelevant goal would make me reconsider.
還在學到東西、目標也仍重要，我就會堅持。如果一直受損，或目標已不適用，就要重新想。
consistent
穩定
What helps you keep a consistent routine when your days are unpredictable?
A small minimum keeps my routine consistent. On busy days, five minutes may be more realistic than abandoning the habit completely.
設定小小的最低量，能讓習慣比較穩定。忙的時候做五分鐘，也比整個放棄實際。
gradual
逐步
When would gradual change be easier to maintain than a complete restart?
A gradual change would suit my morning routine. Moving one task at a time would reveal what actually improved the start of my day.
調整早晨作息，適合逐步來。一次挪一件事，才看得出什麼真的讓早上變順。
temporary
臨時
What would make a temporary arrangement acceptable while a problem was being fixed?
A temporary arrangement needs a clear end point and basic reliability. People should know when to expect another update about the permanent solution.
臨時安排要有明確終點，也得基本可靠。大家應該知道，何時會再收到正式解法的進度。
permanent
永久
What would you test before making a permanent change to your workspace?
Before a permanent change, I would try the layout for a week. Daily use could reveal awkward details that a sketch would miss.
做永久改動前，我會先試用新格局一週。實際每天使用，才會發現草圖漏掉的不方便。
complex
複雜
How would you explain a complex plan without overwhelming the listener?
I would break the complex plan into its purpose and three main parts. Extra detail could wait until the listener understood the structure.
我會把複雜計畫分成目的和三個主要部分。等對方懂架構，再補其他細節。
simple
簡單
When is a simple solution better than a more impressive one?
A simple solution is better when it solves the real problem reliably. Extra features can add work without adding useful value.
能穩定解決真正問題，簡單解法就比較好。功能加很多，可能只多了工作，沒多實際價值。
practical
實際
What would make a well-intentioned suggestion more practical?
A practical suggestion should fit the available time and resources. Naming the first action would make it easier to try.
實際的建議，要符合現有時間和資源。說清楚第一步怎麼做，就比較容易試。
realistic
實際
How would you set a realistic timeline when others expected a faster result?
I would show the work behind a realistic timeline. Explaining dependencies and trade-offs could make the estimate easier to understand.
我會列出實際時程背後要做的事。說明先後依賴和取捨，別人比較能理解估計。
potential
潛力
How would you explore the potential of an idea without committing too much too soon?
I would test the idea's potential with a small real example. Positive feedback would guide another test, not automatically justify a huge investment.
我會用小型真實例子測試想法的潛力。收到好評，就安排下一步驗證，不立刻大筆投入。
